character_tex: $K^{(2M)}_a = \eta(\tau)^{-1}\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}} q^{(a+2Mj)^2/4M}$, the characters of the $U(1)_{2M}$ lattice algebra; at $R^2 = 2M$ the momentum and winding $(n, w)$ have $h = \frac{(n+wM)^2}{4M}$, $\bar h = \frac{(n-wM)^2}{4M}$. Twisted sectors: $|\eta/\theta_4| = |q^{1/48}\prod(1-q^{n-1/2})^{-1}|^2$, $|\eta/\theta_3| = |q^{1/48}\prod(1+q^{n-1/2})^{-1}|^2$, and the untwisted projection uses $|\eta/\theta_2| = \tfrac12|q^{-1/24}\prod(1+q^n)^{-1}|^2$.
description: $S^1/\mathbb{Z}_2$ orbifold ($X\to-X$) of the boson at $R^2 = 4$; the two fixed points give twisted ground states at $h = \bar h = 1/16$.
